reasoning: A covers every rubric point with correct, current APIs and gives a truly non-blocking fix for the join popup. B is solid and adds useful extra findings, but it never names Activated, uses LastInputTypeChanged instead of PreferredInput, doesn't mention TopbarInset or the player's text size setting, and keeps the popup auto-opening after spawn.

criteria.note: Finding #5 (High) cites `rewardOpen = source(true)` and the dim frame with Active at DailyReward.luau:71-77. It recommends a badge in place of auto-open, or opening after the first block is placed, and never in a new player's first seconds.
Finding #6 removes both the countdown and the loss wording, notes the timer does nothing at 0:00, and proposes streaks that pause instead of reset.
Finding #1 is a Blocker that quotes the Community Standards ban on external URLs. It says to delete the label, points to Social Links, and warns against gating on AllowedExternalLinkReferences.
Finding #4 moves the rail to the middle of the right edge, clear of jump. Finding #7 replaces IgnoreGuiInset with CoreUISafeInsets and says to read GuiService.TopbarInset live.
Finding #3 covers Activated, GuiService:Select, SelectionGroup and B to close. Finding #2 covers hover-only labels. Finding #17 replaces TouchEnabled with PreferredInput.
Finding #8 gives 64 px rail buttons, a 220x72 Claim and a 56 px Close against a 10 mm floor. Finding #10 says TextScaled opts out of PreferredTextSize and gives inconsistent sizes.
Covers check mark and 'Today' on the tiles (#11), a WCAG contrast table (#9), the endless pulse and ReducedMotion (#13), and a 6 s toast floor (#14).

Has a clear severity table, element locations, concrete fixes and playtest questions, and the code is untouched. It refers to outside guidelines that aren't in the repo ('Vide skill's references/screens.md', P1-P10) and puts the join modal below the policy and input blockers.
Finding #12 is only Medium. It still auto-opens the popup after spawn plus about 2 s when a reward is claimable, so play is still blocked.
Finding #10 removes the countdown and the threat copy, adds a one-day grace period, and catches the fake timer and the formatTime bug.
Finding #1 says to delete the banner and use Social Links. It then suggests gating an in-game mention on AllowedExternalLinkReferences, which is a weak route.
Finding #4 moves the menu to the middle of an edge, and #6 uses CoreUISafeInsets. It doesn't mention reading GuiService.TopbarInset.
Finding #3 covers selection, B to close and glyphs. It never says to switch to Activated, and #19 suggests LastInputTypeChanged rather than PreferredInput.
Finding #7 gives 56 px menu buttons, a 220x64 CLAIM and a 56 px Close hit area. Finding #18 covers inconsistent TextScaled sizes but not the player's text size setting.
Covers color-only tiles (#14), a contrast table (#9), the endless pulse and ReducedMotion (#13), and a longer toast (#16).
Well organized, with a suggested fix order and useful extra findings (repeat claims, missing hotbar, panel overflow), and the code is untouched. The join modal is ranked too low.

strengths: Hits every rubric point with accurate API names (Activated, PreferredInput, TopbarInset, PreferredTextSize, ViewportDisplaySize)
Join modal recommendation is truly non-blocking: a badge, or opening at a natural pause
Contrast table is correct, and the target sizes are concrete
weaknesses: Refers to outside guidelines and a skill file the team doesn't have
Evidence labels add length without helping the fix pass

strengths: Finds the repeat-claim economy bug and the missing block picker
Covers responsive popup sizing for small phones
Gives a clear fix order and a device checklist
weaknesses: Doesn't name Activated as the input-agnostic event
Uses LastInputType rather than PreferredInput, and ignores PreferredTextSize
